question: What is the production cloud-data omega-grid inversion pipeline design, given the four s059i validators that de-risked it?
hypothesis: Separating the where-to-anchor decision (coarse 50k sweep) from the how-dense-at-anchor decision (400k resample at one anchor) yields a cohort-viable, blind, ~5-10 min/seed inversion pipeline.
narrative_md: Design doc (not a run) for the production cloud-data omega-grid inversion pipeline, de-risked by the four s059i validators. Headline idea: separate where-to-anchor (coarse 50k argmin |C_t| sweep, ~10s) from how-dense-at-anchor (400k resample at one anchor, ~3s) -- 20x setup speedup, zero quality loss. 9-step architecture (anchor -> dense q_a set -> |C_a| cap -> omega-grid -> local-window score -> cluster -> LM polish -> hi-fi gate -> Band A/B yield) with explicit NO TRUTH-CLUSTER INJECTION. Inconclusive: it is a plan; the executed pilot (s059j_cloud_data_omega_grid) later failed the yield gate at N_DIRS=200.
